- products (32,951 rows): Product catalogue. Category names are in Portuguese; join category_translation for English names.
- sellers (3,095 rows): One row per seller on the marketplace.

args.purpose: Check the rating distribution and count of reviews on the most recent dates (2018-08-31 to 2018-09-03)
args.sql:
SELECT 
    review_creation_date::date as review_date,
    count(*) as total_reviews,
    count(review_comment_message) as reviews_with_comments,
    round(avg(review_score), 2) as avg_score,
    sum(case when review_score = 5 then 1 else 0 end) as score_5,
    sum(case when review_score = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as score_1
FROM order_reviews
WHERE review_creation_date >= '2018-08-31'
GROUP BY review_date
ORDER BY review_date DESC

args.answer: Customers who left reviews on the most recent full day in the data (August 31, 2018) expressed predominantly positive sentiment, with 61.9% giving 5 stars and 17.5% giving 4 stars. Positive comments praised fast delivery times, product quality, and well-packaged items, while negative reviews (8.7% giving 1 star) highlighted shipping delays, missing items, or products differing from their descriptions. Overall, satisfaction remained high, consistent with the broader weekly trend where 62.4% of reviews achieved top marks.
